Because MADE_BY is `launcher`, Step 6 says I don't remove the worktree or delete the branch. I'm running no further commands.

SAY: The merge is done: `main` fast-forwarded to `9b50e40` (`src/limits.py` and `tests/test_limits.py`), and the 2 tests pass on the merged result.

SAY: I did not remove the worktree at `/work/atlas/.claude/worktrees/rate-limit`, because the desktop app started this session there and I didn't create it. I also left the branch `claude/rate-limit-4f2a`, since git won't delete a branch that a worktree has checked out. It is already merged into `main`, so nothing is lost by keeping it.

SAY: Before you archive, note that the worktree has an untracked file, `notes.md`. Archiving can discard uncommitted changes in the worktree, usually after asking. If you want to keep `notes.md`, copy it out or commit it first. The app removes the worktree when you archive the session, or about 30 days later if it is kept. The branch can outlive the archive. To clean up by hand, run `git worktree remove /work/atlas/.claude/worktrees/rate-limit` from `/work/atlas`, then `git branch -d claude/rate-limit-4f2a`.
